plan_evidence.strategy: Specialize the destination-owned kernel on a constant column extent and run it mask-free when the extent is an exact multiple of the block and chunk, to cut predication and dispatch work on the shapes that use it.
plan_evidence.code_changes: Owner kernel takes ncols as a tl.constexpr and gains an EVEN constexpr branch that runs the source loop and the final load/store completely unmasked with a compile-time trip count when ncols is an exact multiple of BLOCK and CHUNK (all powers-of-two frozen timing shapes); the masked branch is retained for non-multiple shapes such as the 9-column correctness cases.
plan_evidence.hypothesis: Making the destination-owned kernel's column extent a compile-time constant and removing all masking in its loop reduces per-iteration vector work and dispatch cost, improving the 1024x1024 and 128x128 shapes without changing the 2048x2048 atomic path.

expected_effect.mechanism: Predication and per-chunk mask arithmetic removed from the destination-owned hot loop, plus one fewer runtime argument to specialize per launch.

reason: 优化计划明确记载改法；结合其中的假设与测量推断主要判断来源。

plan_evidence.strategy: Fix the round-2 memory-locality mistake: keep the sorted-segment algorithm but stage the sorted keys and cumsum row in registers and run the whole run-location search with on-chip tl.gather instead of per-lane dynamic global loads.
plan_evidence.code_changes: Rewrote _scatter_add_sort_out_kernel so the combine pass issues only two contiguous row loads (sorted keys, cumsum) and then performs all lookups with on-chip tl.gather: the 12-step branchless binary search now gathers from the register-resident key vector instead of issuing a per-lane dynamic global load per step, and the begin/end prefix lookups plus the lane shift also use on-chip gathers. Round 2's structure, dispatch (ncols<=256 owner, <=4096 sorted, else atomic) and numerics are unchanged.
plan_evidence.hypothesis: Round 2's regression came entirely from the combine pass performing its search with data-dependent global loads; staging the sorted keys and the cumsum row once and searching on-chip recovers the predicted latency, so the six wide-row timing workloads should reach ~1.25x/1.32x and lift geo_mean well above the 0.411 baseline.

expected_effect.mechanism: Removes 14 per-lane dynamic global gathers per row from the combine pass and replaces them with on-chip gathers that measured ~25x cheaper per gather, cutting the six wide-row workloads' latency from 6.72/28.6 ms back toward the 0.7/2.5 ms predicted by the isolated ingredient costs.
